cell.reason: Mesh exports no prefixed C allocation API. Its published interface is the malloc/free override itself, so there is no symbol for a #[global_allocator] shim to call that is distinguishable from libc's. Verified against the pinned commit: no mesh_malloc / mz_malloc equivalent exists in its headers.
